# Disabled and enabled successor DBs must both survive old-daemon refusal exactly.
server start
server stop
old-state-refusal
skygo --json state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
retention-domain DOMAIN
old-state-refusal
server start
taskfile task.json success
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id still-valid --wait
event-count 1
server stop
! stderr .
